description: Slack is a team communication platform. Pro plan costs $7.25/month per user; free tier limits message history to 90 days.

alternatives.name: Mattermost
alternatives.reason: Open-source Slack alternative with self-hosting, unlimited message history, and enterprise features.

alternatives.name: Element
alternatives.reason: Free and open-source messaging built on the Matrix protocol, end-to-end encrypted, self-hostable.

alternatives.name: Zulip
alternatives.reason: Free open-source team chat with topic-based threading, better for organized discussions than Slack.

alternatives.name: Rocket.Chat
alternatives.reason: Fully open-source team communication platform, self-hostable, supports omnichannel and real-time translation.

faqs.question: Is there a free alternative to Slack?
faqs.answer: Yes. Mattermost, Element, Zulip, and Rocket.Chat are all free open-source alternatives.

faqs.question: Is Slack open source?
faqs.answer: No. Slack is proprietary. Mattermost and Element are fully open-source alternatives.

faqs.question: Can I self-host a team chat?
faqs.answer: Yes. Mattermost, Element, Zulip, and Rocket.Chat all support self-hosting.

faqs.question: Which Slack alternative has unlimited message history?
faqs.answer: Self-hosted Mattermost, Element, and Zulip all offer unlimited message history for free.

faqs.question: What is the most secure Slack alternative?
faqs.answer: Element uses the Matrix protocol with end-to-end encryption by default.

description: Trello is a Kanban-style project management tool. Standard plan costs $5/month per user.

alternatives.name: WeKan
alternatives.reason: Free and open-source Kanban board, self-hostable, supports Trello import for easy migration.

alternatives.name: Focalboard
alternatives.reason: Free open-source project management tool by Mattermost, Trello-like interface, self-hostable.

alternatives.name: Taiga
alternatives.reason: Free open-source project management with Kanban and Scrum, designed for agile teams.

faqs.question: Is there a free alternative to Trello?
faqs.answer: Yes. WeKan, Focalboard, and Taiga are all free open-source Kanban and project management tools.

faqs.question: Can I import my Trello boards?
faqs.answer: Yes. WeKan supports direct Trello board import for easy migration.

faqs.question: Is there a self-hosted Kanban board?
faqs.answer: Yes. WeKan, Focalboard, and Taiga all support self-hosting.
